description: Whale trades on any token — the latest big buys and sells (time, side, USD, token amount, price, wallet, tx, pool, dex) newest first, plus the top 10 net buyer and top 10 net seller wallets, whale buy/sell/net USD totals and a net_buying / net_selling / mixed lean. Top 3 pools by liquidity. Chains: base, ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, solana. 404/free if no trade above the floor; 503/free if the trade source is down. Costs $0.01 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.

address.description: Token contract (0x + 40 hex on EVM chains) or Solana mint

min_usd.description: smallest trade to count in USD, 100-1000000, default 5000
